(async () => {


const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][ComeMyAmigo]";


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


const CFG = {


animationKey: "come-my-amigo-summon",


// Formation


formationXOffsetPx: (canvas.grid?.size ?? 100) * 1.8, // right of summoner


verticalGapPx: (canvas.grid?.size ?? 100) * 1.2, // spread vertically


// Summon animation timing


fadeMs: 420,


staggerMs: 160,


// Pseudo visual layer


pseudoZIndex: 9500,


// Reveal / ending buffer


finalBufferMs: 120,


// Chat


chatTextColor: "#e8dcc0",


chatAccentColor: "#9f7a3d"


};


const NORMAL_POOL = [


{ name: "Bandit", uuid: "Actor.o1jFZwDZxSAFSSWA" },


{ name: "Bandit Archer", uuid: "Actor.XFBIZY3EKMHgBQCx" },


{ name: "Bandit Mage", uuid: "Actor.ndwgiiXLxsr6lqE0" }


];


const ELITE_POOL = [


{ name: "Elite Bandit", uuid: "Actor.qkogIO0dEtQ466Wo" },


{ name: "Bandit Berserker", uuid: "Actor.Ax1nVCBhZOG0ZzHx" }


];


const wait = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function ensureONIEmit() {


globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};


if (!ONI.emit) {


ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {


const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


}


function escapeHTML(value) {


const s = String(value ?? "");


return foundry?.utils?.escapeHTML ? foundry.utils.escapeHTML(s) : s;


}


function clamp(value, min, max) {


return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);


}


function parseTintToNumber(value) {


if (value == null || value === "") return 0xFFFFFF;


if (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value)) return value >>> 0;


if (typeof value === "string") {


const cleaned = value.trim().replace(/^#/, "").replace(/^0x/i, "");


const n = Number.parseInt(cleaned, 16);


return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : 0xFFFFFF;


}


return 0xFFFFFF;


}


function pickRandom(arr) {


return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];


}


async function resolvePlaceableFromUuid(uuid) {


if (!uuid) return null;


const doc = await fromUuid(uuid);


return doc?.object ?? doc?._object ?? null;


}


async function resolveSourceToken() {


const candidates = [


payload?.attackerTokenUuid,


payload?.sourceTokenUuid,


payload?.casterTokenUuid,


payload?.tokenUuid,


payload?.attackerUuid,


payload?.sourceUuid,


payload?.casterUuid,


payload?.originUuid


].filter(Boolean);


for (const uuid of candidates) {


const token = await resolvePlaceableFromUuid(uuid);


if (token) return token;


}


return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;


}


async function getActorByUuid(uuid) {


const actor = await fromUuid(uuid);


if (!actor) throw new Error(`Actor not found for uuid: ${uuid}`);


return actor;


}


async function buildHiddenSummonTokenData(actor, desiredCenter, sourceToken) {

  const gridSize = canvas.grid?.size ?? 100;

  const sceneRect = canvas.dimensions?.sceneRect ?? {

    x: 0,

    y: 0,

    width: canvas.scene?.width ?? 10000,

    height: canvas.scene?.height ?? 10000

  };


  const tokenDoc = await actor.getTokenDocument({

    hidden: true,

    disposition: sourceToken.document?.disposition ?? -1

  });


  const data = tokenDoc.toObject();


  const tokenWidthPx = Number(data.width ?? 1) * gridSize;

  const tokenHeightPx = Number(data.height ?? 1) * gridSize;


  const x = clamp(

    Math.round(desiredCenter.x - (tokenWidthPx / 2)),

    sceneRect.x,

    Math.round(sceneRect.x + sceneRect.width - tokenWidthPx)

  );


  const y = clamp(

    Math.round(desiredCenter.y - (tokenHeightPx / 2)),

    sceneRect.y,

    Math.round(sceneRect.y + sceneRect.height - tokenHeightPx)

  );


  data.x = x;

  data.y = y;

  data.hidden = true;

  data.disposition = sourceToken.document?.disposition ?? data.disposition;


  // Force summoned enemies to face left toward the party

  data.texture = data.texture ?? {};

  data.texture.scaleX = -Math.abs(Number(data.texture.scaleX ?? 1));


  return data;

}


async function addSummonsToCombat(createdDocs) {


const combat = game.combat;


if (!combat) return;


const combatSceneId = combat.scene?.id ?? combat.sceneId ?? null;


if (combatSceneId !== canvas.scene?.id) return;


const existingTokenIds = new Set(combat.combatants.map((c) => c.tokenId));


const toCreate = createdDocs


.filter((doc) => !existingTokenIds.has(doc.id))


.map((doc) => ({


tokenId: doc.id,


actorId: doc.actorId,


sceneId: canvas.scene.id


}));


if (toCreate.length) {


await combat.createEmbeddedDocuments("Combatant", toCreate);


}


}


async function postArrivalMessage(name) {

  const safeName = escapeHTML(name);

  const content = `

   

      ${safeName} Arrive!

   

  `.trim();


  const data = {

    content,

    speaker: {

      scene: null,

      actor: null,

      token: null,

      alias: ""

    },

    author: game.user.id

  };


  // In your setup, style is fine. The broken field was "type".

  if (CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_STYLES?.OTHER != null) {

    data.style = CONST.CHAT_MESSAGE_STYLES.OTHER;

  }


  await ChatMessage.create(data);

}


function buildFormationCenters(sourceToken) {


const home = { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };


const baseX = home.x + Number(CFG.formationXOffsetPx);


// Top normal, center elite, bottom normal


return [


{ x: baseX, y: home.y - Number(CFG.verticalGapPx) },


{ x: baseX, y: home.y },


{ x: baseX, y: home.y + Number(CFG.verticalGapPx) }


];


}


function buildSummonPseudoScript() {


return `


const { params } = ctx;


function clamp01(v) {


return Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), 1);


}


function easeOutCubic(t) {


return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);


}


function colorLerp(fromHex, toHex, t) {


const aR = (fromHex >> 16) & 0xff;


const aG = (fromHex >> 8) & 0xff;


const aB = fromHex & 0xff;


const bR = (toHex >> 16) & 0xff;


const bG = (toHex >> 8) & 0xff;


const bB = toHex & 0xff;


const r = Math.round(aR + (bR - aR) * t);


const g = Math.round(aG + (bG - aG) * t);


const b = Math.round(aB + (bB - aB) * t);


return (r << 16) | (g << 8) | b;


}


function tweenMs(durationMs, onUpdate) {


return new Promise((resolve) => {


const dur = Math.max(1, Number(durationMs) || 1);


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const start = performance.now();


const tick = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / dur;


const t = clamp01(raw);


onUpdate(t);


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(tick);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(tick);


});


}


async function playOne(spec, cfg, layer) {


const tex = await loadTexture(spec.textureSrc);


const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


sprite.anchor.set(0.5);


sprite.x = Number(spec.centerX);


sprite.y = Number(spec.centerY);


sprite.width = Number(spec.spriteWidthPx);

sprite.height = Number(spec.spriteHeightPx);


sprite.alpha = 0;

sprite.tint = 0x000000;

sprite.zIndex = Number(cfg.zIndex ?? 9500);


layer.addChild(sprite);

layer.sortChildren?.();


// Preserve explicit facing

sprite.scale.x = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x) * (spec.flipX ? -1 : 1);

sprite.scale.y = Math.abs(sprite.scale.y) * (spec.flipY ? -1 : 1);


const finalTint = Number(spec.finalTintHex ?? 0xFFFFFF);


await tweenMs(Number(cfg.fadeMs ?? 420), (t) => {


const e = easeOutCubic(t);


sprite.alpha = e;


sprite.tint = colorLerp(0x000000, finalTint, e);


});


if (sprite.parent) sprite.parent.removeChild(sprite);


sprite.destroy();


}


const layer = new PIXI.Container();


layer.zIndex = Number(params.cfg?.zIndex ?? 9500);


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


canvas.stage.addChild(layer);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


try {


const specs = Array.isArray(params.spawnSpecs) ? params.spawnSpecs : [];


const cfg = params.cfg ?? {};


for (let i = 0; i < specs.length; i++) {


if (i > 0) {


await wait(Number(cfg.staggerMs ?? 160));


}


await playOne(specs[i], cfg, layer);


}


} finally {


if (layer.parent) layer.parent.removeChild(layer);


layer.destroy({ children: true, texture: false, baseTexture: false });


}


`.trim();


}


ensureONIEmit();


let sourceToken = null;


let createdDocs = [];


try {


sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();


if (!sourceToken) {


ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found for Come! My Amigo!");


return;


}


const selectedNormalA = pickRandom(NORMAL_POOL);


const selectedNormalB = pickRandom(NORMAL_POOL);


const selectedElite = pickRandom(ELITE_POOL);


// Formation order: normal / elite / normal


const selectedWave = [selectedNormalA, selectedElite, selectedNormalB];


const formationCenters = buildFormationCenters(sourceToken);


ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {


type: CFG.animationKey,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,


targetTokenIds: [],


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


const prepared = [];


for (let i = 0; i < selectedWave.length; i++) {


const picked = selectedWave[i];


const actor = await getActorByUuid(picked.uuid);


const tokenData = await buildHiddenSummonTokenData(actor, formationCenters[i], sourceToken);


prepared.push({ picked, actor, tokenData });


}


createdDocs = await canvas.scene.createEmbeddedDocuments(


"Token",


prepared.map((p) => p.tokenData)


);


await addSummonsToCombat(createdDocs);


const gridSize = canvas.grid?.size ?? 100;


const spawnSpecs = createdDocs.map((doc, i) => {


const data = doc.toObject();


const centerX = Number(data.x ?? 0) + ((Number(data.width ?? 1) * gridSize) / 2);


const centerY = Number(data.y ?? 0) + ((Number(data.height ?? 1) * gridSize) / 2);


const scaleXAbs = Math.abs(Number(data.texture?.scaleX ?? 1));


const scaleYAbs = Math.abs(Number(data.texture?.scaleY ?? 1));


return {


tokenUuid: doc.uuid,


name: doc.name,


textureSrc: data.texture?.src ?? doc.texture?.src ?? prepared[i]?.actor?.img,


centerX,


centerY,


spriteWidthPx: (Number(data.width ?? 1) * gridSize) * scaleXAbs,


spriteHeightPx: (Number(data.height ?? 1) * gridSize) * scaleYAbs,


flipX: Number(data.texture?.scaleX ?? 1) < 0,


flipY: Number(data.texture?.scaleY ?? 1) < 0,


finalTintHex: parseTintToNumber(data.texture?.tint)


};


});


if (game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {


game.ONI.pseudo.play({


scriptId: "oni.comeMyAmigo.summonWave",


scriptSource: buildSummonPseudoScript(),


casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,


targetTokenUuids: [],


params: {


spawnSpecs,


cfg: {


fadeMs: CFG.fadeMs,


staggerMs: CFG.staggerMs,


zIndex: CFG.pseudoZIndex


}


},


meta: { source: "Come! My Amigo!" }


});


} else {


console.warn(TAG, "game.ONI.pseudo.play is unavailable. Summons will reveal without pseudo VFX.");


}


// Reveal the real tokens in sync with the pseudo fade


if (createdDocs[0]) {


await wait(CFG.fadeMs);


await createdDocs[0].update({ hidden: false });


await postArrivalMessage(createdDocs[0].name);


}


for (let i = 1; i < createdDocs.length; i++) {


await wait(CFG.staggerMs + CFG.fadeMs);


await createdDocs[i].update({ hidden: false });


await postArrivalMessage(createdDocs[i].name);


}


await wait(CFG.finalBufferMs);


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);


ui.notifications.error("Come! My Amigo! summon animation failed. Check console.");


} finally {


try {


ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {


type: CFG.animationKey,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,


targetTokenIds: createdDocs.map((d) => d.id),


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


} catch (endErr) {


console.error(TAG, "Failed to emit animationEnd:", endErr);


}


}


})();

"";

}

attackerDoc?.object ??

attackerDoc?._object ??

canvas.tokens?.placeables?.find(t => t.actor?.id === attackerActor?.id) ??

null;

attackerToken?.document ??

(attackerDoc?.documentName === "Token" ? attackerDoc : null);

attackerTokenDoc?.disposition ??

attackerActor?.prototypeToken?.disposition ??

-1

);

const getCurrentHp = (actor) => {

return Math.max(

0,

parseInt(String(actor?.system?.props?.current_hp ?? "0"), 10) || 0

);

function getCasterUuid() {

payload.attackerUuid ||

payload.casterTokenUuid ||


payload?.meta?.attackerUuid ||

null


);

anchorX,


anchorY,


scaleXSign,


scaleYSign,


rotation,


alpha,


gainAmount

  enemyLossCount: enemyLossPlan.length,

  allyGainCount: allyGainPlan.length

});


function sleep(ms) {


return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));


}


function easeInOutCubic(t) {


return t < 0.5


? 4 * t * t * t


: 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


}


function animateXY(obj, fromX, toX, fromY, toY, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


if (!durMs || durMs <= 0) {


obj.x = toX;


obj.y = toY;


resolve();


return;

const e = easeFn(t);


obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;


obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


function tweenNumber(onUpdate, from, to, durMs, easeFn = easeInOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


if (!durMs || durMs <= 0) {


onUpdate(to);


resolve();


return;


}

const start = performance.now();


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

onUpdate(from + ((to - from) * e));


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}

const DEFAULT_FLAG_SCOPE = "world";

const DEFAULT_FLAG_KEY = "rockYourWorld_choice";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

const attackerUuid = p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "";

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker actor.");

return;

}

// Prefer the live payload copy first, then fall back to the constant stored slot

const storedChoice =

p?.meta?.rockYourWorldChoice ??

attackerActor.getFlag(

p?.meta?.rockYourWorldFlagScope ?? DEFAULT_FLAG_SCOPE,

p?.meta?.rockYourWorldFlagKey ?? DEFAULT_FLAG_KEY

);

if (!storedChoice?.effectUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No stored Rock your World choice found.");

return;

}

const sourceEffectDoc = await fromUuid(storedChoice.effectUuid);

if (!sourceEffectDoc) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve source Active Effect UUID:", storedChoice.effectUuid);

return;

}

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.warn(TAG, "No targets found.");

return;

}

const baseEffectData = sourceEffectDoc.toObject();

delete baseEffectData._id;

delete baseEffectData.id;

baseEffectData.origin = storedChoice.effectUuid;

baseEffectData.transfer = false;

baseEffectData.disabled = false;

baseEffectData.flags = foundry.utils.deepClone(baseEffectData.flags ?? {});

baseEffectData.flags.world = foundry.utils.deepClone(baseEffectData.flags.world ?? {});

baseEffectData.flags.world.rockYourWorld = {

choiceId: storedChoice.id,

label: storedChoice.label,

sourceEffectUuid: storedChoice.effectUuid,

sourceActorUuid: attackerActor.uuid,

sourceActorName: attackerActor.name,

appliedAt: Date.now()

};

let appliedCount = 0;

for (const targetUuid of targetUuids) {

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(targetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Skipping unresolved target:", targetUuid);

continue;

}

// Refresh same buff instead of stacking duplicates

const existing = targetActor.effects.filter(e => {

const mark = e.getFlag("world", "rockYourWorld") ?? {};

return (

e.origin === storedChoice.effectUuid ||

(mark?.choiceId === storedChoice.id &&

mark?.sourceActorUuid === attackerActor.uuid) ||

e.name === sourceEffectDoc.name

);

});

if (existing.length) {

await targetActor.deleteEmbeddedDocuments(

"ActiveEffect",

existing.map(e => e.id)

);

}

const effectData = foundry.utils.deepClone(baseEffectData);

const created = await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [effectData]);

appliedCount += created.length;

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

target: targetActor.name,

choice: storedChoice.label,

effectName: effectData.name

});

}

console.log(TAG, "DONE", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

choice: storedChoice.label,

targetCount: targetUuids.length,

appliedCount

});

ui.notifications.info(`Rock your World applied ${storedChoice.label} to ${appliedCount} target(s).`);

(async () => {


const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][LoveSerenade]";


// =========================


// TUNING


// =========================

animationKey: "loveSerenade",


// spotlight / screen dim


spotlightLeadMs: 280,

markerStartScale: 0.20,


markerEndScale: 3.00,


markerScaleInMs: 700,

boonSfx: "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/PowerUp2.ogg",

boonFadeOutMs: 350,


boonZ: 100100,


// music swap


musicTrackName: "Love_Serenade",


musicRestoreTrackName: "DRG_Boss",


musicDurationMs: 104000


};


// =========================


// HELPERS


// =========================


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function ensureONIEmit() {


globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};


if (!ONI.emit) {


ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {


const { local = true, world = false } = options;


if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);


if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });


};


}


}


async function resolveToken(input) {


if (!input) return null;


if (input?.center && input?.document) return input;


const doc = typeof input === "string" ? await fromUuid(input) : input;


if (!doc) return null;


if (doc.object?.center) return doc.object;


if (doc._object?.center) return doc._object;


if (doc.token?.object?.center) return doc.token.object;


if (doc.parent?.token?.object?.center) return doc.parent.token.object;


if (doc.actor?.getActiveTokens) {


const t = doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0];


if (t) return t;


}


return null;


}


async function resolveSourceToken(payload) {


const candidates = [


payload?.attackerUuid,


payload?.sourceTokenUuid,


payload?.casterTokenUuid,


payload?.tokenUuid,


payload?.executor?.tokenUuid,


payload?.executor?.token?.uuid,


payload?.meta?.sourceTokenUuid


].filter(Boolean);


for (const c of candidates) {


const tok = await resolveToken(c);


if (tok) return tok;


}


return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0]


?? game.user.character?.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0]


?? null;


}


function uniqueTokens(tokens) {


const seen = new Set();


return (tokens || []).filter(t => {


const id = t?.id ?? t?.document?.uuid;


if (!id || seen.has(id)) return false;


seen.add(id);


return true;


});


}


function getEnemySideAllies() {


const all = canvas.tokens?.placeables ?? [];


return all.filter(t => {


if (!t || t.document?.hidden) return false;


return Number(t.document?.disposition ?? 0) === -1;


});


}


function getCutinUrl(sourceToken) {


return foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken, "actor.system.props.cut_in_zero_power")


|| foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken, "actor.system.props.cut_in_critical")


|| foundry.utils.getProperty(sourceToken, "actor.system.props.sprite_standard")


|| sourceToken.actor?.img


|| sourceToken.document?.texture?.src


|| null;


}


function playSound(url, volume = 0.9, delayMs = 0) {


if (!url) return;


const seq = new Sequence();


seq.sound().file(url).volume(volume).delay(delayMs);


seq.play();


}


function playPseudo({ scriptId, scriptSource, casterToken, targetTokens = [], params = {}, meta = {} }) {


if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {


throw new Error("game.ONI.pseudo.play is not available.");


}


game.ONI.pseudo.play({


scriptId,


scriptSource,


casterTokenUuid: casterToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,


targetTokenUuids: targetTokens.map(t => t?.document?.uuid).filter(Boolean),


params,


meta


});


}


async function stopAllPlayingTracks() {


for (const playlist of game.playlists.contents) {


const playingSounds = playlist.sounds.filter(s => s.playing);


if (!playingSounds.length) continue;


const updates = playingSounds.map(s => ({


_id: s.id,


playing: false,


pausedTime: null


}));


await playlist.updateEmbeddedDocuments("PlaylistSound", updates);


}


}


async function playTrackByName(trackName) {


const wanted = String(trackName ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();


if (!wanted) return null;


for (const playlist of game.playlists.contents) {


const sound = playlist.sounds.find(s =>


String(s.name ?? "").trim().toLowerCase() === wanted


);


if (!sound) continue;


await playlist.updateEmbeddedDocuments("PlaylistSound", [{


_id: sound.id,


playing: true,


pausedTime: null


}]);


return { playlist, sound };


}


console.warn(TAG, `Track not found: ${trackName}`);


return null;


}


async function runLoveSerenadeMusicCue() {


try {


await stopAllPlayingTracks();


const started = await playTrackByName(CFG.musicTrackName);


if (!started) return;


await waitMs(CFG.musicDurationMs);


await stopAllPlayingTracks();


await playTrackByName(CFG.musicRestoreTrackName);


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Music cue failed:", err);


}


}


// =========================


// PSEUDO SCRIPTS


// =========================


const spotlightScript = String.raw`

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Love Serenade spotlight: missing casterToken.");


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

  return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}


function tweenValue(setter, from, to, durMs, ease = easeInOutCubic) {

  return new Promise(resolve => {

    const start = performance.now();

    const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

    const update = () => {

      const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

      const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

      const e = ease(t);

      setter(from + (to - from) * e, t);

      if (t >= 1) {

        ticker.remove(update);

        resolve();

      }

    };

    ticker.add(update);

  });

}


function circleRadiusForToken(token, extra = 30) {

  const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

  const w = Math.abs(baseObj?.width ?? token.w ?? 100);

  const h = Math.abs(baseObj?.height ?? token.h ?? 100);

  return Math.max(w, h) * 0.62 + Number(extra ?? 0);

}


function buildOverlay(tokens, alphaNow) {

  const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;

  const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;


  const g = new PIXI.Graphics();

  g.beginFill(0x000000, 1);

  g.drawRect(0, 0, W, H);

  g.endFill();


  for (const tok of tokens) {

    if (!tok) continue;

    const r = circleRadiusForToken(tok, params.spotlightExtraRadius ?? 34);

    g.beginHole();

    g.drawCircle(tok.center.x, tok.center.y, r);

    g.endHole();

  }


  g.alpha = alphaNow;

  g.zIndex = Number(params.zOverlay ?? 99990);


  if (PIXI?.filters?.BlurFilter && Number(params.spotlightBlur ?? 0) > 0) {

    g.filters = [new PIXI.filters.BlurFilter(Number(params.spotlightBlur ?? 16))];

  }


  return g;

}


async function createTokenClone(token) {

  const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

  const tex = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);


  const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


  const ax = Number(baseObj?.anchor?.x ?? 0.5);

  const ay = Number(baseObj?.anchor?.y ?? 0.5);

  sprite.anchor.set(ax, ay);


  sprite.x = token.center.x;

  sprite.y = token.center.y;

  sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zClone ?? 100000);

  sprite.rotation = Number(baseObj?.rotation ?? 0);

  sprite.alpha = Number(baseObj?.alpha ?? token.alpha ?? 1);


  // Copy the exact live token scale instead of rebuilding size from width/height.

  const scaleX = Number(baseObj?.scale?.x ?? 1);

  const scaleY = Number(baseObj?.scale?.y ?? 1);

  sprite.scale.set(scaleX, scaleY);


  return {

    token,

    baseObj,

    sprite,

    originalTokenVisible: token.visible,

    originalMeshVisible: baseObj?.visible ?? true

  };

}


const keep = [];

const pushUnique = (tok) => {

  if (!tok) return;

  if (keep.some(x => x.id === tok.id)) return;

  keep.push(tok);

};


pushUnique(casterToken);

for (const t of targetTokens) pushUnique(t);


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


let overlay = null;

const clones = [];


try {

  overlay = buildOverlay(keep, 0);

  canvas.stage.addChild(overlay);


  for (const tok of keep) {

    const entry = await createTokenClone(tok);


    if (entry.baseObj) entry.baseObj.visible = false;

    entry.token.visible = false;


    canvas.stage.addChild(entry.sprite);

    clones.push(entry);

  }


  canvas.stage.sortChildren();


  await tweenValue(

    v => { if (overlay) overlay.alpha = v; },

    0,

    Number(params.dimAlpha ?? 0.75),

    Number(params.fadeInMs ?? 320),

    easeOutCubic

  );


  await waitMs(Number(params.totalHoldMs ?? 3000));


  await tweenValue(

    v => { if (overlay) overlay.alpha = v; },

    overlay?.alpha ?? Number(params.dimAlpha ?? 0.75),

    0,

    Number(params.fadeOutMs ?? 420),

    easeOutCubic

  );


} finally {

  for (const entry of clones) {

    try {

      if (entry.sprite?.parent) entry.sprite.parent.removeChild(entry.sprite);

      entry.sprite?.destroy();

    } catch (_) {}


    try {

      if (entry.baseObj) entry.baseObj.visible = entry.originalMeshVisible;

      entry.token.visible = entry.originalTokenVisible;

    } catch (_) {}

  }


  try {

    if (overlay?.parent) overlay.parent.removeChild(overlay);

    overlay?.destroy();

  } catch (_) {}

}

`;


const cutinScript = String.raw`


const { params } = ctx;


const cutinUrl = params.cutinUrl;


if (!cutinUrl) return;


const waitMs = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, Number(ms) || 0)));


function easeOutCubic(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }


function easeInOutCubic(t) {


return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;


}


function tweenValue(setter, from, to, durMs, ease = easeInOutCubic) {


return new Promise(resolve => {


const start = performance.now();


const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;


const update = () => {


const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;


const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);


const e = ease(t);


setter(from + (to - from) * e, t);


if (t >= 1) {


ticker.remove(update);


resolve();


}


};


ticker.add(update);


});


}


async function loadTextureSafe(src) {


try { return await loadTexture(src); }


catch (err) {


console.warn("[LoveSerenade][CutIn] Failed to load texture:", src, err);


return null;


}


}


const W = canvas.app.renderer.screen.width;


const H = canvas.app.renderer.screen.height;


canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;


const overlay = new PIXI.Container();


overlay.zIndex = Number(params.zOverlay ?? 999999);


const flash = new PIXI.Graphics();


flash.beginFill(0xFFFFFF, 1).drawRect(0, 0, W, H).endFill();


flash.alpha = 0;


let portrait = null;


try {


const tex = await loadTextureSafe(cutinUrl);


if (!tex) return;


portrait = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);


portrait.anchor.set(0, 1);


const targetHeight = H * Number(params.portraitHeightRatio ?? 0.90);


const scale = targetHeight / (portrait.texture?.height || 1);


portrait.scale.set(scale);


const startX = -portrait.width - 80;


const finalX = Number(params.portraitInsetX ?? 220);


const y = (H - Number(params.portraitBottomMargin ?? 40)) + Number(params.portraitYOffset ?? -140);


portrait.x = startX;


portrait.y = y;


overlay.addChild(flash, portrait);


canvas.stage.addChild(overlay);


canvas.stage.sortChildren();


await waitMs(Number(params.flashDelayMs ?? 50));


const flashIn = tweenValue(v => { flash.alpha = v; }, 0, Number(params.flashPeak ?? 0.9), Number(params.flashInMs ?? 70), easeOutCubic)


.then(() => tweenValue(v => { flash.alpha = v; }, flash.alpha, 0, Number(params.flashOutMs ?? 170), easeOutCubic));


await tweenValue(v => { portrait.x = v; }, startX, finalX, Number(params.slideInMs ?? 650), easeInOutCubic);


await flashIn;


await waitMs(Number(params.holdMs ?? 850));


await tweenValue(v => { portrait.x = v; }, portrait.x, W + 60, Number(params.slideOutMs ?? 650), easeInOutCubic);


} finally {


try {


if (overlay?.parent) overlay.parent.removeChild(overlay);


overlay?.destroy({ children: true, texture: false, baseTexture: false });


} catch (_) {}


}


`;

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {


ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");


return;


}


ensureONIEmit();


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken(payload);


if (!sourceToken) {


ui.notifications.warn("Love Serenade: no caster token found.");


return;


}


const enemyAllies = uniqueTokens(getEnemySideAllies());


const allyTargets = uniqueTokens([sourceToken, ...enemyAllies]);


const cutinUrl = getCutinUrl(sourceToken);


const cutinTotalMs =


CFG.cutinSlideInMs +


CFG.cutinHoldMs +


CFG.cutinSlideOutMs +


120;


const markerTotalMs =


CFG.markerScaleInMs +


CFG.markerHoldMs +


CFG.markerFadeOutMs +


80;


const boonTotalMs =


CFG.boonFadeInMs +


CFG.boonHoldMs +


CFG.boonFadeOutMs +


80;


const spotlightHoldMs =


CFG.spotlightLeadMs +


cutinTotalMs +


markerTotalMs +


boonTotalMs +


120;


ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {


type: CFG.animationKey,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,


targetTokenIds: allyTargets.map(t => t.id),


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


// 1) Start spotlight dim / ally illumination


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.spotlight",


scriptSource: spotlightScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


targetTokens: allyTargets.filter(t => t.id !== sourceToken.id),


params: {

  dimAlpha: CFG.spotlightDimAlpha,

  fadeInMs: CFG.spotlightFadeInMs,

  fadeOutMs: CFG.spotlightFadeOutMs,

  spotlightBlur: CFG.spotlightBlur,

  spotlightExtraRadius: CFG.spotlightExtraRadius,

  totalHoldMs: spotlightHoldMs,

  zOverlay: CFG.spotlightZ,

  zClone: CFG.spotlightCloneZ

},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(CFG.spotlightLeadMs);


// 2) Cut-in


if (cutinUrl) {


playSound(CFG.cutinSfx, CFG.cutinSfxVol, 0);


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.cutin",


scriptSource: cutinScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


params: {


cutinUrl,


slideInMs: CFG.cutinSlideInMs,


holdMs: CFG.cutinHoldMs,


slideOutMs: CFG.cutinSlideOutMs,


flashPeak: CFG.cutinFlashPeak,


flashDelayMs: CFG.cutinFlashDelayMs,


flashInMs: CFG.cutinFlashInMs,


flashOutMs: CFG.cutinFlashOutMs,


portraitHeightRatio: CFG.cutinPortraitHeightRatio,


portraitInsetX: CFG.cutinPortraitInsetX,


portraitBottomMargin: CFG.cutinPortraitBottomMargin,


portraitYOffset: CFG.cutinPortraitYOffset,


zOverlay: CFG.cutinZ


},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(cutinTotalMs);


}


// 3) Caster marker VFX + music swap


void runLoveSerenadeMusicCue();


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.marker",


scriptSource: markerScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


params: {


vfxFile: CFG.markerVfxFile,


startScale: CFG.markerStartScale,


endScale: CFG.markerEndScale,


scaleInMs: CFG.markerScaleInMs,


holdMs: CFG.markerHoldMs,


fadeOutMs: CFG.markerFadeOutMs,


alpha: CFG.markerAlpha,


zIndex: CFG.markerZ


},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(markerTotalMs);


// 4) Ally boon VFX + sound


playSound(CFG.boonSfx, CFG.boonSfxVol, 0);


playPseudo({


scriptId: "oni.loveSerenade.boonAllies",


scriptSource: boonScript,


casterToken: sourceToken,


targetTokens: allyTargets.filter(t => t.id !== sourceToken.id),


params: {


vfxFile: CFG.boonVfxFile,


scale: CFG.boonScale,


fadeInMs: CFG.boonFadeInMs,


holdMs: CFG.boonHoldMs,


fadeOutMs: CFG.boonFadeOutMs,


zIndex: CFG.boonZ


},


meta: { source: "Love Serenade" }


});


await waitMs(boonTotalMs);


console.log(TAG, "END");


} catch (err) {


console.error(TAG, "Animation crashed:", err);


} finally {


try {


const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};


const sourceToken = await (async () => {


try { return await resolveSourceToken(payload); } catch (_) { return null; }


})();


ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {


type: CFG.animationKey,


sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null,


sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,


timestamp: Date.now()


}, { local: true, world: false });


} catch (_) {}


}


})();
